Dedup is in, keyed on `event.key` with a `Map` in `createState()` (`src/router.js:41`).

- 99 drops, which is exactly the flap events `events.js` seeds (every 9th, re-firing 2 minutes later on the previous key).
- I record the timestamp only when something actually went out, so a dropped repeat doesn't extend the 5-minute window — the clock runs from the last real send.
- The check runs before quiet hours, so a queued notification counts as sent and its repeat is dropped rather than queued again.

Two judgment calls worth your eye. I read "in the last 5 minutes" as inclusive (`<= 5`), so a repeat at exactly 5 minutes is dropped; the seeded flaps are at +2 so this edge doesn't affect the counts either way. And I applied dedup to every priority including critical — 99 drops includes some criticals, which is why `pager` fell from 225 to 200. If critical should always break through, that's a one-line exemption.
